description: Capture print() calls inside compute and route them to context.log.info as Dagster log events. Perfect for porting legacy scripts that use print() for visibility, and for third-party libraries that write to stdout (pandas warnings, tqdm progress, etc.). Wraps compute with contextlib.redirect_stdout; each newline-terminated line becomes one Dagster log event. Companion `@log_prints` decorator.

outputs.description: One @dg.asset. Every print() call in compute becomes an info log event. Original stdout restored after compute.

asset_name.description: Dagster asset name. Required when NOT using `wraps:` (inherited from inner in wraps mode).
asset_name.label: Asset Name

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.description: Prepended to every captured line before it lands in the log.

route_levels.label: Route Levels
route_levels.description: If True (default), captured lines starting with `INFO:` / `WARN:` / `WARNING:` / `ERROR:` / `DEBUG:` route to `context.log.<level>()`. Case-insensitive; the prefix is stripped from the emitted message. Unmatched lines fall back to `.info` for stdout and `.warning` for stderr.

capture_stderr.label: Capture Stderr
capture_stderr.description: If True, also redirect `sys.stderr` into `context.log`. Stderr lines default to `context.log.warning` (or level-routed when `route_levels=True`). Default False (stdout only).

name: Log Prints Asset
